column1: # This repository's dictation vocabulary (GitHub #12670), highest priority
# first: TERM<TAB>SOUNDS|LIKE. Parakeet rescores look-alike spans with these
# (psionic/lib/parakeet/vocab.coax); a term replaces a span only when the
# transducer scores it within PKV_BIAS of what it recognized. At most 64 terms
# are used. Terms never hold a digit, and only characters the model has pieces
# for (no underscore: say "snake case" with --format code instead). Product and code names only: an
# ordinary English word here would compete with that word everywhere.
